Definition: a Shuchite or descendant of Shuach
BiblicalUsage: Shuchi is a Shuhite, a descendant of Shuach, and the only bearer of the title in Scripture is Bildad, one of Job's three friends. He came from his own place to mourn with Job and comfort him, he answered Job three times, and at the end he went and did according as the Lord commanded, and the Lord accepted Job.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Bildad came with good intentions and bad theology. He sat with Job in his grief, and I hold that his presence was right even when his answers were wrong.
